about: Curated drag-sim roster from @CleetusM transcripts. Every value cites video_id@timestamp from extract/. kind: measured = timeslip/dyno/scale read in the video; stated = said by the team without proof shown; estimate = team's own estimate; null = not said in the 46 processed videos. Dyno numbers are as stated (wheel vs crank is rarely specified).

kinds.measured: timeslip, dyno sheet or scale read in the video
kinds.stated: said by the team without the number being shown
kinds.modeled: not in the research; derived by the game from the calibration data or a documented rule, with the reason
